acceptanceCriteria: Resolved as the finding's Fix describes, with a regression test for any code change, or closed by an owner decision that rejects the finding.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review (main report or Beamfall/corvint-tasks addendum; confirmed by at least one verifier). Finding text: **F2. A pending redo blocks reads, can be cleared only with the primary on the intent branch, and readers report in-flight writers as crashes.** - **Severity:** medium. - **Core:** no. - **Location:** `tasks-src/internal/store/redo.go:52` (`requireBranch` before redo) and `store.go` `settled()`. - **Failure:** - After a C2 crash, `queue status`, `ticket list`, `roadmap`, `ticket show` and `gate list` return NOT_RUN REDO_PENDING. `release list` still works. - An agent on a feature branch cannot recover, because the retry is refused with INTENT_BRANCH_MISMATCH. - Under a concurrent writer, 14 of 60 reads returned REDO_PENDING with crash remediation text. - **Fix:** - Add a branch-independent `recover` verb, since redo only replays committed bytes. - Have readers try a non-blocking flock and report WRITER_ACTIVE when it is held. - Name the branch precondition in the remediation text. - **Votes:** 1/0/1. - **Known ticket:** none.
